originalTitle: 1 Software Stock Worth Investigating and 2 We Avoid
summary: From commerce to culture, software is digitizing every aspect of our lives. The undeniable tailwinds fueling the industry have also led to strong returns for SaaS stocks lately as they’ve gained 47.6% over the past six months, outpacing the S&P 500’s 12.3% rise.
content:
From commerce to culture, software is digitizing every aspect of our lives. The undeniable tailwinds fueling the industry have also led to strong returns for SaaS stocks lately as they've gained 47.6% over the past six months, outpacing the S&P 500's 12.3% rise.

Although these businesses have produced results, only the best will survive over the long term as AI is eating into the profits of those with lower switching costs. Taking that into account, here is one software stock poised to generate sustainable market-beating returns and two we're steering clear of.

Born from the need to create ironclad protection in an increasingly dangerous digital world, Commvault (NASDAQ:CVLT) provides data protection and cyber resilience software that helps organizations secure, back up, and recover their data across on-premises, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments.

Average billings growth of 12.2% over the last year was subpar, suggesting it struggled to push its software and might have to lower prices to stimulate demand

Extended payback periods on sales investments suggest the company's platform isn't resonating enough to drive efficient sales conversions

Efficiency fell over the last year as its operating margin declined by 1.5 percentage points because it pursued growth instead of profits

Commvault's stock price of $136.32 implies a valuation ratio of 4.4x forward price-to-sales. To fully understand why you should be careful with CVLT, check out our full research report (it's free) .

Starting as a database company in 1977 and now powering mission-critical systems across the globe, Oracle (NYSE:ORCL) provides enterprise software and hardware products and services that help businesses manage their information technology needs.

Scale is a double-edged sword because it limits the company's growth potential compared to its smaller competitors, as reflected in its below-average annual revenue increases of 10.7% for the last five years

Capital intensity will likely ramp up in the next year as its free cash flow margin is expected to contract by 19.1 percentage points

Unfavorable liquidity position could lead to additional equity financing that dilutes shareholders

At $150.96 per share, Oracle trades at 5x forward price-to-sales. Read our free research report to see why you should think twice about including ORCL in your portfolio, it's free .

Operating in the often-overlooked smaller metropolitan markets where HR expertise can be scarce, Asure Software (NASDAQ:ASUR) provides cloud-based human capital management software and services that help small and medium-sized businesses manage payroll, taxes, time tracking, and HR compliance.

Products and services have many advocates, as seen in its respectable 16.1% annual sales growth over the last two years

Billings have averaged 26.2% growth over the last year, showing it's securing new contracts that could potentially increase in value over time

Well-designed software integrates seamlessly with other workflows, enabling swift payback periods on marketing expenses and customer growth at scale

Asure Software is trading at $9.08 per share, or 1.5x forward price-to-sales. Is now the time to initiate a position? See for yourself in our comprehensive research report, it's free .

chineseTitle: 1 值得研究的软件库存和 2 我们避免的软件库存
chineseSummary: 从商业到文化，软件正在使我们生活的方方面面数字化。不可否认的推动该行业的利好因素最近也为 SaaS 股票带来了强劲回报，它们在过去六个月中上涨了 47.6%，超过了标准普尔 500 指数 12.3% 的涨幅。
chineseContent:
从商业到文化，软件正在使我们生活的方方面面数字化。不可否认的推动该行业的利好因素最近也为 SaaS 股票带来了强劲回报，它们在过去六个月中上涨了 47.6%，超过了标准普尔 500 指数 12.3% 的涨幅。

尽管这些企业已经取得了成果，但从长远来看，只有最好的企业才能生存，因为人工智能正在蚕食那些转换成本较低的企业的利润。考虑到这一点，这里有一只软件股票有望产生可持续的跑赢市场的回报，而另外两只我们正在避开。

Commvault（纳斯达克股票代码：CVLT）因需要在日益危险的数字世界中创建可靠的保护而诞生，它提供数据保护和网络弹性软件，帮助组织跨本地、混合和多云环境保护、备份和恢复数据。

去年平均账单增长率为 12.2%，低于平均水平，这表明该公司在推广其软件方面遇到了困难，可能不得不降低价格来刺激需求

销售投资回收期延长表明该公司的平台没有引起足够的共鸣，无法推动有效的销售转化

由于追求增长而不是利润，去年效率下降，营业利润率下降了 1.5 个百分点

Commvault 的股价为 136.32 美元，意味着估值比率为 4.4 倍的远期市销率。要充分了解为什么您应该小心 CVLT，请查看我们的完整研究报告（免费）。

Oracle（纽约证券交易所代码：ORCL）于 1977 年作为一家数据库公司起步，如今为全球的关键任务系统提供支持，提供企业软件和硬件产品及服务，帮助企业管理其信息技术需求。

规模是一把双刃剑，因为与较小的竞争对手相比，它限制了公司的增长潜力，过去五年低于平均水平的年收入增长率 10.7% 就反映了这一点

明年资本密集度可能会上升，因为其自由现金流利润率预计将收缩 19.1 个百分点

不利的流动性状况可能导致额外的股权融资，从而稀释股东权益

甲骨文的股价为每股 150.96 美元，其交易价格是远期市销率的 5 倍。阅读我们的免费研究报告，了解为什么您应该三思而后行，将 ORCL 纳入您的投资组合中，它是免费的。

Asure Software（纳斯达克股票代码：ASUR）在经常被忽视的人力资源专业知识匮乏的小都市市场运营，提供基于云的人力资本管理软件和服务，帮助中小型企业管理工资、税收、时间跟踪和人力资源合规性。

产品和服务拥有众多拥护者，过去两年销售额年增长率高达 16.1%

比林斯去年的平均增长率为 26.2%，这表明它正在获得新合同，这些合同的价值可能会随着时间的推移而增加

精心设计的软件可与其他工作流程无缝集成，从而实现营销费用的快速回报期和大规模客户增长

Asure Software 的交易价格为每股 9.08 美元，即远期市销率的 1.5 倍。现在是建仓的时候吗？请亲自查看我们的综合研究报告，它是免费的。

适合所有市场条件的优质股票

当您在这里时：排名前九的跑赢市场的股票。最好的股票不会只跑赢市场一次。他们又这么做了。又来了。强劲的收入增长、不断增长的自由现金流、资本回报率让他们在竞争中遥遥领先。市场已经给这些企业带来了回报。

但我们的人工智能平台表示派对还没有结束。免费了解本周有哪些 9 只股票被下调。在这里免费获取我们排名前 9 位的跑赢市场股票。

2020 年进入我们名单的股票包括现在熟悉的名字，如 Nvidia（2020 年 6 月至 2025 年 6 月期间上涨 1,460%），以及曾经不为人知的企业，如曾经的微型股公司 Tecnoglass（2020 年 6 月至 2025 年 6 月期间上涨 1,552%）。立即通过 StockStory 寻找您的下一个大赢家。
